visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair, round black glasses, wearing a cream sweater and a pearl necklace, speaks into a small black microphone in a brightly lit office environment with a computer and skincare products. (2) She moves her hands expressively to explain a concept, while Traditional Chinese subtitles and colorful variety text overlays appear at the bottom of the screen to emphasize her speech. (3) A visual cut shows a close-up of healthy-looking brown hair being tossed, followed by an animation of a hair strand being filled with small purple particles to illustrate ingredient absorption. (4) Another transition shows long, straight dark hair with glowing sparkles, followed by a macro view of a hair follicle on a scalp being blocked by a greyish substance. (5) Macro shots follow, displaying an oily scalp and hair strands with distinct red inflammation spots to illustrate the consequences of using incorrect hair products. (6) The woman holds up a blue and white bottle of Pregaine shampoo, gesturing toward the label and ingredient list shown in close-up, while a cartoon hair-washing icon appears. (7) The video ends with a brand logo for DRX Series Skincare on a clean grey background with white geometric lines radiating from the center.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: DRX 達特仕保養品. [Subtitle]: 為什麼油性肌膚的洗髮精. (2) [Subtitle]: 要選擇比較透明質地的呢? (3) [Subtitle]: 如果你今天你是選擇洗髮潤髮二合一的. (4) [Variety]: 你洗完之後頭髮要順滑. (5) [Subtitle]: 那一定是那一罐洗髮精裡面添加了某一個成分. (6) [Subtitle]: 把這頭髮的這角質層把它堵進去. (7) [Variety]: 不是所有矽靈類的東西都會導致痘痘. (8) [Subtitle]: 而是當它比例很高的時候 它會堵塞到頭皮的毛囊裡面. (9) [Variety]: 越洗越油 越來越多痘痘. (10) [Subtitle]: 因為通常這些東西它都是以一個不透明狀的成分產生. (11) [Slogan]: 建議 成分表越短越好. (12) [Logo]: Pregaine. (13) [Subtitle]: 洗起來不舒服 它不香. (14) [Variety]: 澀澀的 但是! (15) [Logo]: DRX Series Skincare.

A high-tempo electronic pop background music track with a prominent synth melody and a steady 4/4 beat is audible. (2) A synthesized "whoosh" sound effect marks a visual transition as the speaker continues her explanation with a friendly and professional tone, maintaining high articulation clarity and moderate vocal arousal. (4) An impact-like SFX occurs during a scene showing scalp issues, accompanied by a slight shift in the narrator's prosody to sound more emphatic and urgent before returning to a helpful tone. (5) A light sparkling or twinkling sound effect accompanies an animation illustrating hair follicle health, as the speaker enthusiastically introduces a specific shampoo brand with increased vocal volume. narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem Analysis -> Scientific Explanation -> Solution Recommendation -> Conclusion.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers with oily scalps on why they should avoid two-in-one shampoos and instead choose transparent, single-function products like Pregaine. It uses a combination of direct address, animation, and macro-photography to provide evidence of scalp issues caused by certain ingredients before concluding with a direct product recommendation.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The speaker holds the product, discusses its benefits in detail, and shows the packaging and brand name clearly while suggesting it to the audience.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-quality production combining educational content with influencer marketing. The use of animations and macro shots effectively builds credibility for the product endorsement.
